bounds.domain: One renderer, one local host session, one account replacement, two consent attempts, one Cloud session and three independently funded windows. Integer window boundaries abstract at most 60-second acknowledged expiry increments. Missing, stale, foreign, unnegotiated and post-Stop acknowledgements cannot create a window.
bounds.mapping: reset maps to the bounded pre-admission ECONNRESET retry. mint/allocated map to the prepared recovery journal and paid ledger; hostAck maps to cloud-speech-relay-client and VoiceSession.renewLease; clientAck maps to the current socket generation and negotiated session ID. Closed retains every allocated settlement receipt, including stopped reservations.
bounds.conformance: Mandatory strict replay runs actual host, renderer, SQLite/HTTP/WS app and real Chromium fake-device flow checks. The browser runs longer than a real 60-second window and crosses the production relay kernel with synthetic STT/TTS, independently recorded zero-price per-window receipts and canonical retirement transitions.
bounds.limitations: Finite boundary abstraction, not whole-program refinement or production qualification. It does not establish real provider recognition, audio quality, billing infrastructure, persistence across process death, mobile hardware or service latency. Existing speech_continuity separately models the detailed per-window backend settlement and unknown acknowledgements. Conditional progress is limited to explicitly fair terminal receipt availability; no real-time deadline is proved.

assumptions: Each allocated window eventually supplies its terminal STT and TTS settlement receipt; each continuously enabled settlement and confirmation continuation is weakly fair. No network or provider success is assumed for safety.
Without external settlement and continuation fairness, closed sessions may remain unconfirmed indefinitely.
